## Raon-OpenTTS

[Raon-OpenTTS](https://github.com/krafton-ai/Raon-OpenTTS) is KRAFTON's open-weight **and** open-data TTS family ([arXiv:2605.20830](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20830)): an F5-TTS-style flow-matching Diffusion Transformer over 80-channel mels at 16 kHz, with a HiFi-GAN vocoder. Trained on 510K hours of open data; the 1B matches or beats closed-data SOTA on Seed-TTS-Eval (WER 1.78%, SIM 0.749). Zero-shot voice cloning needs only a short reference clip and its transcript.

## ComfyUI links
- [Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Raon-OpenTTS](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Raon-OpenTTS)
- [🤗 drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui)

## About this workflow

Zero-shot voice cloning: **Load Model** → **Whisper Transcribe** (builds the reference transcript) → **Generate**.

**Key inputs**

- **weights**: `int8-convrot` (smallest, comfy-kitchen INT8 kernels) or `bf16` (fastest). fp32 is conversion reference and is not listed
- **ref_audio / ref_text**: clean 3–10 s reference clip + its exact transcript (the Whisper node transcribes for you)
- **steps**: NFE steps, 32 is the official default; lower is faster and rougher
- **cfg_strength**: 2.0 official; higher follows the text harder
- **speed**: speech-rate estimate multiplier (>1 = faster)
- **seed**: 42 default, repeatable (+1 per text chunk); 0 = random
- **use_vad_duration**: official VAD-based length estimate; keep on for quiet/short references

Long text is chunked and cross-faded automatically. Output is 16 kHz mono.

## Model Links
[🤗 drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui) (all builds; the loader auto-downloads) · [🤗 KRAFTON/Raon-OpenTTS-1B](https://huggingface.co/KRAFTON/Raon-OpenTTS-1B) (original) · [🤗 KRAFTON/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B](https://huggingface.co/KRAFTON/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B) (original)

The loader downloads the selected model folder (config, vocab, weights) plus the HiFi-GAN vocoder from the ComfyUI repo when `download_if_missing` is on.

Files land in `ComfyUI/models/raon_opentts/`

**Raon-OpenTTS-1B** (1042M params)

- [Raon-OpenTTS-1B-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-1B/Raon-OpenTTS-1B-int8-convrot.safetensors) (1.41 GB, smallest)
- [Raon-OpenTTS-1B-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-1B/Raon-OpenTTS-1B-bf16.safetensors) (2.08 GB, fastest)
- [config.yaml](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-1B/config.yaml) · [vocab.txt](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-1B/vocab.txt)

**Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B** (339M params)

- [Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B-int8-convrot.safetensors) (0.50 GB, smallest)
- [Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B-bf16.safetensors) (0.68 GB, fastest)
- [config.yaml](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B/config.yaml) · [vocab.txt](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/Raon-OpenTTS-0.3B/vocab.txt)

**vocoder** (shared, auto-downloaded)

- [tts-hifigan-libritts-16kHz/generator.ckpt](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Raon-OpenTTS-comfyui/resolve/main/tts-hifigan-libritts-16kHz/generator.ckpt)
